## Zhāng Lǔ {.unnumbered #zhanglu}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Zhāng Lǔ appellation Gōngqí was a Pèi state Fēng man. His grandfather [Zhāng] Líng was a guest in Shǔ, studied the Dào in the Húmíng mountains, composed Dào books to confuse the Hundred Surnames, those that received the Dào from him contributed five dǒu of rice, therefore the era called them the Rice Bandits. [Zhāng] Líng died, his son [Zhāng] Héng enacted his Dào. [Zhāng] Héng died, [Zhāng] Lǔ further enacted it. Yì Province Governor Liú Yān appointed [Zhāng] Lǔ as Supervising Righteousness Major, with Separate Division Major Zhāng Xiū leading troops to strike Hànzhōng Administrator Sū Gù, [Zhāng] Lǔ therefore surprise attacked [Zhāng] Xiū and killed him, seized his multitudes. [Liú] Yān died, his son [Liú] Zhāng succeeded the position, as [Zhāng] Lǔ was not obedient, completely killed [Zhāng] Lǔ's mother and family household. [Zhāng] Lǔ therefore occupied Hànzhōng, instructed the people with Ghost Dào, titled himself "Preceptor Lord." Those that came to study the Dào first all were named "Ghost Soldiers" Those that received the basic Dào and were already trusted were titled "Libationers," each managed a division of multitudes, those with many were "Governing Head Libationers." All taught to be honest and faithful and not to deceive and cheat, those will illness self confessed their transgressions, overall with the Huángjīn resembling one another. The various Libationers all made Charity Lodges, like the present's Precinct Relays. Also installed charity rice and meat, hanging in the Charity Lodges, travelers judged their hunger and took enough. If they took excessively much, the Ghost Dào at once made them ill. Violators of law had three pardons, and afterward then enacted execution. They did not install Chief Clerks, all used the Libationers for governance, the civilians and Yí were convenienced and happy with them. He dominated and occupied Bā and Hàn reaching to thirty years. <a href="#annotation-41" id="source-41">[41]</a> At Hàn's end, his strength could not be campaigned against, and therefore instead favored [Zhāng] Lǔ as Defending the People Central Cadet General, designate Hànníng Administrator, to provide tribute and nothing more. Among the civlians someone inside the ground found a jade seal, the various subordinates wished to honor [Zhāng] Lǔ as King of Hànníng. [Zhāng] Lǔ's Merit Officer Bāxī's Yán Pǔ remonstrated [Zhāng] Lǔ stating: "The civilians of Hànchuān, the households exceed a hundred thousand, resources abundant and soil fertile, four sides rugged and firm. Best is to rectify Heaven's Son, which then is to become Huán and Wén. Next is to reach Dòu Róng, to not lose riches ahd honor.^[Duke Huán of Qí and Duke Wén of Jìn were the celebrated hegemons of the Spring and Autumn era who dominated the realm but used their real power to support the weak but legitimate Zhōu dynasty. Dòu Róng was a regional warlord during the Xīn-Later Hàn transition era who surrendered to Liú Xiù and was able to keep his riches and honor.] Now you Uphold Regulations to install officials, powerful sufficient to behead and decide, without the bother of being a King. May you for now not declare title, to not precede disaster." [Zhāng] Lǔ followed this. In the chaos of Hán Suì and Mǎ Chāo, the civilians west of the passes that followed Zǐwǔ valley to flee to him were several tens of thousands of families.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
張魯字公祺，沛國豐人也。祖父陵，客蜀，學道鵠鳴山中，造作道書以惑百姓，從受道者出五斗米，故世號米賊。陵死，子衡行其道。衡死，魯復行之。益州牧劉焉以魯為督義司馬，與別部司馬張脩將兵擊漢中太守蘇固，魯遂襲脩殺之，奪其眾。焉死，子璋代立，以魯不順，盡殺魯母家室。魯遂據漢中，以鬼道教民，自號「師君」。其來學道者，初皆名「鬼卒」。受本道已信，號「祭酒」。各領部眾，多者為治頭大祭酒。皆教以誠信不欺詐，有病自首其過，大都與黃巾相似。諸祭酒皆作義舍，如今之亭傳。又置義米肉，縣於義舍，行路者量腹取足；若過多，鬼道輒病之。犯法者，三原，然後乃行刑。不置長吏，皆以祭酒為治，民夷便樂之。雄據巴、漢垂三十年。〔一〕漢末，力不能征，遂就寵魯為鎮民中郎將，領漢寧太守，通貢獻而已。民有地中得玉印者，群下欲尊魯為漢寧王。魯功曹巴西閻圃諫魯曰：「漢川之民，戶出十萬，財富土沃，四面險固；上匡天子，則為桓、文，次及竇融，不失富貴。今承制署置，勢足斬斷，不煩於王。願且不稱，勿為禍先。」魯從之。韓遂、馬超之亂，關西民從子午谷奔之者數萬家。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-41" id="annotation-41">[41]</a> Diǎnlüè states: During Xīpíng [172 - 178] witch rebels greatly rose up,^[Witch rebels (yāozéi) referred to rebels and bandit groups that followed heterdox cult beliefs said to bewitch the masses.] The Three Adjuncts had Luò Yào. During Guānghé [178 - 184], the east had Zhāng Jué, Hànzhōng had Zhāng Xiū. Luò Yào taught people the Miǎn Nì Fǎ,^[The meaning of Miǎn Nì Fǎ "Distant Hiding Method" is no longer known for certain, but it has been speculated to have been some sort of invisibility technique.] [Zhāng] Jué made the Tàipíng^["Grand Peace"] Dào, [Zhāng] Xiū made the Five Dǒu of Rice Dào. In the Tàipíng Dào, the Preceptor held a nine joint cane for charms and prayer, instructed sick people to knock head^[Knock head (kòutóu) is to bow the head to touch the forehead the ground. The term is the source of the loan word "kowtow."] and think on their transgressions, and then give charmed water to them to drink. For the ill that perhaps in days grew less serious and then recovered, then they said this person believed in the Dào. For those that perhaps did not recover, then they did not believe in the Dào. [Zhāng] Xiū's ways were roughly the same with [Zhāng] Jué, but added the use of quiet rooms, having the sick reside inside to think on their transgressions. Also employed people as Treachery Corrector Libationers. Libationers managed with the Lāo-zǐ's five thousand words. Those sent to supervise studies were titled as Treachery Correctors. Those that were Ghost clerks managed making prayers for the sick. The method of making prayers was to write the sick person's family name and personal name, state the intention to admit guilt, make three copies, one up to Heaven by placing atop a mountain, one buried in the ground, one submerged in a river, called as the Three Offices Hand Writings. Had the sick's family contribute rice of five dǒu as the standard, therefore they were called the Five Dǒu of Rice Preceptors. In fact it was without benefit to treating illness, it was only excessive absurdity, however the petty men were ignorant and foolish, and competed together to serve it. Later [Zhāng] Jué was executed, [Zhāng] Xiū also died. Reaching to when [Zhāng] Lǔ was at Hànzhōng, he took advantage of its people believing and enacting [Zhāng] Xiū's enterprise, and therefore augmented and embellished it. He instructed to have them make Charity Lodges, with rice and meat installed inside for staying travelers. Also instructed them in self examination.^[The term zì yǐn here is also often interpreted as "self concealment," as in to not show off.] Those that had small transgressions, were to repair roads for a hundred bù,^[The word for road (dào) is the same word for Dào as in the religious concept.] then the crime was expunged. Also complied with Monthly Ordinances,^[Monthly Ordinances (yuè lìng) refered to standards and practices based on seasonal and monthly differences.] spring and summer prohibited killing, also prohibited alcohol. Those in exile that moved and entrusted themselves to the land did not dare not observe the practices.

Your Servant Sōngzhī says Zhāng Xiū should be Zhāng Héng. If it is not Diǎnlüè's mistake, then it is a transmission copyist error.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　典略曰：熹平中，妖賊大起，三輔有駱曜。光和中，東方有張角，漢中有張脩。駱曜教民緬匿法，角為太平道，脩為五斗米道。太平道者，師持九節杖為符祝，教病人叩頭思過，因以符水飲之，得病或日淺而愈者，則云此人信道，其或不愈，則為不信道。脩法略與角同，加施靜室，使病者處其中思過。又使人為姦令祭酒，祭酒主以老子五千文，使都習，號為姦令。為鬼吏，主為病者請禱。請禱之法，書病人姓名，說服罪之意。作三通，其一上之天，著山上，其一埋之地，其一沉之水，謂之三官手書。使病者家出米五斗以為常，故號曰五斗米師。實無益于治病，但為淫妄，然小人昏愚，競共事之。後角被誅，脩亦亡。及魯在漢中，因其民信行脩業，遂增飾之。教使作義舍，以米肉置其中以止行人；又教使自隱，有小過者，當治道百步，則罪除；又依月令，春夏禁殺；又禁酒。流移寄在其地者，不敢不奉。臣松之謂張脩應是張衡，非典略之失，則傳寫之誤。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Jiàn'ān Twentieth Year [215], Tàizǔ then from Sǎn Pass set out Wǔdū to campaign against him, reached Yángpíng Pass. [Zhāng] Lǔ wished to lead Hànzhōng to surrender, his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi did not agree, led multitudes of several tens of thousands of men to resist at the pass and firmly defend. Tàizǔ attacked and defeated them, and therefore entered Shǔ. <a href="#annotation-42" id="source-42">[42]</a> [Zhāng] Lǔ heard Yángpíng had already fallen, was about to bow forehead and submit to surrender, [Yán] Pǔ again said: "Now as you are forced to go, your achievement will certainly be light. It is not as good as depending on Dù Huò and going to Piáo Hú to resist together, and only afterward pledging hostages, your achievements will certainly be many." Thereupon he then fled to the southern mountains and entered Bāzhōng. The Left and Right wished to completely burn all the treasures and goods and granaries and storehouses, [Zhāng] Lǔ said: "I originally wished to submit to the mandate of the country, but my intentions were not conveyed. Now to flee is to avoid a sharp advance, not to have malicious intentions. The treasures and goods and granaries and storehouses are the country's possession." Therefore he sealed the storages and left. Tàizǔ entered Nánzhèng, extremely commended this. Also as [Zhāng] Lǔ originally had good intentions, sent someone to reassure and explain. [Zhāng] Lǔ completely led his family to go out, Tàizǔ faced and appointed [Zhāng] Lǔ as Defending South General, treated with the rituals for a guest, enfeoffed as Marquess of Làngzhōng,^[Làngzhōng county was in Bā prefecture.] estate ten thousand households. Enfeoffed five of [Zhāng] Lǔ's sons with [Yán] Pǔ and others all as Ranked Marquesses. <a href="#annotation-43" id="source-43">[43]</a> For his son Péngzǔ obtained [Zhāng] Lǔ's daughter.^[Péngzǔ was the appellation of Cáo Yǔ.] [Zhāng] Lǔ died, posthumous name on him called Yuán-hóu. His son [Zhāng] Fù succeeded. <a href="#annotation-44" id="source-44">[44]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
建安二十年，太祖乃自散關出武都征之，至陽平關。魯欲舉漢中降，其弟衛不肯，率眾數萬人拒關堅守。太祖攻破之，遂入蜀。〔一〕魯聞陽平已陷，將稽顙〔歸降〕，圃又曰：「今以迫往，功必輕；不如依（杜灌）〔杜濩〕赴朴胡相拒，然後委質，功必多。」於是乃奔南山入巴中。左右欲悉燒寶貨倉庫，魯曰：「本欲歸命國家，而意未達。今之走，避銳鋒，非有惡意。寶貨倉庫，國家之有。」遂封藏而去。太祖入南鄭，甚嘉之。又以魯本有善意，遣人慰喻。魯盡將家出，太祖逆拜魯鎮南將軍，待以客禮，封閬中侯，邑萬戶。封魯五子及閻圃等皆為列侯。〔二〕為子彭祖取魯女。魯薨，諡之曰原侯。子富嗣。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-42" id="annotation-42">[42]</a> Wèi Míng Chén Zòu records Dǒng Zhāo's memorial stating: "Wǔ Huángdì received reports from the Liáng Province Following Official and Wǔdū surrendered men, saying that Zhāng Lǔ was easy to attack, that below Yángpíng city walls the southern and northern mountains were far apart, and could not be defended, and believed it as correct. When he went and saw and walked it, it was not as he heard, thus he sighed and said: 'Other people's assessments are rarely like one's thinking.' Attacked the various garrisons atop Yángpíng's mountains, they could not be timely captured, and the wounded soldiers were many. Wǔ Huángdì's thoughts were frustrated, so he wished to evacuate the army to cut across the mountains and return, sending former General-in-Chief Xiàhóu Dūn and General Xǔ Chǔ to call the troops atop the mountains to return. It happened that the front army had not yet returned, in the night got lost, mistakenly entered the rebel camp, the rebels then retreated and scattered. Attendant Centrals Xīn Pí and Liú Yè and others were to the troops' rear, spoke to [Xiàhóu] Dūn and [Xǔ] Chǔ saying: 'The government troops have already occupied and taken the rebel's critical garrison, the rebels are already scattered and fleeing.' They did not yet believe it. [Xiàhóu] Dūn advanced to personally see, and then returned to report to Wǔ Huángdì. Advanced troops to settle them, by good fortune succeeding in capturing. This is a resent event, what the clerks and servicemen know." Also Yáng Jì's memorial states: "When Wǔ Huángdì first campaigned against Zhāng Lǔ, he had multitudes of a hundred thousand, personally oversaw and walked, directing and instructing the overall strategy, taking advantage of civilian wheat for army provisions. Zhāng Wèi's defense overall is not worth discussing. The land is rugged and defense easy, even with elite troops and tiger officers, their strength cannot be used. Facing troops for three days, he wished to pull out the army and return, saying: 'I have been in the army for thirty years, in one morning to hand it over to another, how can it be?' This plan was already settled, Heaven blessed Great Wèi, [Zhāng] Lǔ's defense on its own broke, and we took advantage to settle it."

Shìyǔ states: [Zhāng] Lǔ sent his Five Office Assistant to surrender, his younger brother [Zhāng] Wèi across the mountains built Yángpíng city to resist, the Royal Brigades could not advance. [Zhāng] Lǔ fled to Bāzhōng. The army's provisions were exhausted, Tàizǔ was about to return. West Department Assistant Dōng prefecture's Guō Chén said: "It cannot be. [Zhāng] Lǔ has already surrendered, the remaining envoy has not yet returned, and even if [Zhāng] Wèi is in disagreement, he is without support and can be attacked. For a hanging army deeply penetrated, to advance is to certainly succeed, to retreat is to certainly not escape." Tàizǔ doubted this. In the night there were wild deer of several thousand charging and breaking [Zhāng] Wèi's camp, the army was greatly alarmed. In the night Gāo Zuò and others mistakenly encountered [Zhāng] Wèi's multitudes, [Gāo] Zuò and the rest sounded many drums and horns to gather their multitudes. [Zhāng] wèi was afraid, believed the main army was surprise attacking, and therefore surrendered.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏名臣奏載董昭表曰：「武皇帝承涼州從事及武都降人之辭，說張魯易攻，陽平城下南北山相遠，不可守也，信以為然。及往臨履，不如所聞，乃歎曰：『他人商度，少如人意。』攻陽平山上諸屯，既不時拔，士卒傷夷者多。武皇帝意沮，便欲拔軍截山而還，遣故大將軍夏侯惇、將軍許褚呼山上兵還。會前軍未還，夜迷惑，誤入賊營，賊便退散。侍中辛毗、劉曄等在兵後，語惇、褚，言『官兵已據得賊要屯，賊已散走』。猶不信之。惇前自見，乃還白武皇帝，進兵定之，幸而克獲。此近事，吏士所知。」又楊暨表曰：「武皇帝始征張魯，以十萬之眾，身親臨履，指授方略，因就民麥以為軍糧。張衛之守，蓋不足言。地險守易，雖有精兵虎將，勢不能施。對兵三日，欲抽軍還，言『作軍三十年，一朝持與人，如何』。此計已定，天祚大魏，魯守自壞，因以定之。」世語曰：魯遣五官掾降，弟衛橫山築陽平城以拒，王師不得進。魯走巴中。軍糧盡，太祖將還。西曹掾東郡郭諶曰：「不可。魯已降，留使既未反，衛雖不同，偏攜可攻。縣軍深入，以進必克，退必不免。」太祖疑之。夜有野麋數千突壞衛營，軍大驚。夜，高祚等誤與衛眾遇，祚等多鳴鼓角會眾。衛懼，以為大軍見掩，遂降。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-43" id="annotation-43">[43]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Although Zhāng Lǔ had a good heart, he was forced by defeat and afterward surrendered, now then to be favored with ten thousand households, five sons all enfeoffed as Marquesses, it is excessive.

Xí Zuòchǐ states: [Zhāng] Lǔ wished to declare himself King, but Yán Pvu remonstrated and stopped him, now [Yán] Pǔ is enfeoffed as a Ranked Marquess. Rewards and punishments are in order to punish the bad and encourage the good. If they can be used to make clear standards and instructments to the people, there is no regard to far or near or obscurity or depth. Now Yán Pǔ remonstrated [Zhāng] Lǔ to not be a King, and so Tàizǔ in recollection enfeoffed him, of the people of the future who will not think of obedience? Blocking the original source and the later flow on its own stops, this is what it is speaking of. If instead one does not understand this and only values the achievements of scorched ruin, abundant nobility and generous rewards stopping at servicemen of death battles, then the people will seek profit in having chaos, customs will be to compete in killing and attacking, relying on trops and wielding strength, shields and spears wll not be put away. Tàizǔ in this enfeoffment, can be said to understand the root of reward and punishment, even if Tāng and Wǔ^[Tāng was the founding King of the Shāng dynasty, Wǔ the founding King of the Zhōu dynasty.] had been in this position, they could not have added to it.

Wèilüè states: During Huángchū [220 - 226], augmented [Yán] Pǔ's noble title and estate, among those given Ritual Invitations.^[The phrase "ritual invitations" (lǐ qǐng) generally refers to receiving invitations with formal ritual ceremonies, but the context here suggests it may be a more technical term here that is no longer fully understood.] Later in over ten years he died of illness.

Jìn shū says: Western Róng Major Yán Zuǎn was [Yán] Pǔ's grandson.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　臣松之以為張魯雖有善心，要為敗而後降，今乃寵以萬戶，五子皆封侯，過矣。習鑿齒曰：魯欲稱王，而閻圃諫止之，今封圃為列侯。夫賞罰者，所以懲惡勸善也，苟其可以明軌訓於物，無遠近幽深矣。今閻圃諫魯勿王，而太祖追封之，將來之人孰不思順！塞其本源而末流自止，其此之謂與！若乃不明於此而重燋爛之功，豐爵厚賞止於死戰之士，則民利於有亂，俗競於殺伐，阻兵仗力，干戈不戢矣。太祖之此封，可謂知賞罰之本，雖湯武居之，無以加也。魏略曰：黃初中，增圃爵邑，在禮請中。後十餘歲病死。晉書云：西戎司馬閻纘，圃孫也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-44" id="annotation-44">[44]</a> Wèi lüè states: Liú Xióngmíng was a Lántián man. In youth he used collecting herbs and shooting and hunting as his work, always residing below Fùchē mountain. Every morning and night, he went out walking in clouds and mist, using his knowledge of the roads to not get lost, but the people of the time therefore said he was able to become cloud and mist. In the chaos of Guō [Sì] and Lǐ [Jué], many people joined him. During Jiàn'ān he submitted himself to the province and prefecture, the province and prefecture recommended him as a minor officer. When Mǎ Chāo and the rest rebelled, he would not agree to follow them, [Mǎ] Chāo attacked him. Later he visited Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ grasped his hand and spoke to him stating: "When I was about to enter the passes, I dreamed of obtaining one divine man, was it you?" Thus generously treated him, memorializing to appoint him a General, sent to command and welcome his division group. The division group did not wish to surrender, therefore seized him to rebel, various fugitives all went to depend on him, he had multitudes of several thousand men, occupying Wǔ Pass's road mouth. Tàizǔ sent Xiàhóu Yuān to suppress and defeated him, [Liú] Xióngmíng fled south to Hànzhōng. When Hànzhōng was defeated, destitute with nowhere to go, he thus again submitted to surrender. Tàizǔ grabbed his beard and said: "Old bandit, I truly got you!" Restored his office, transferred to Bóhǎi. At the time also there were Chéng Yín, Hóu Xuǎn, Lǐ Kān, all Hédōng men. In the chaos of Xīngpíng [194 - 195], each had multitudees of over a thousand families. Jiàn'ān Sixtheenth Year [211], they all united with Mǎ Chāo. [Mǎ] Chāo was defeated and fled, [Lǐ] Kān facing the battle lines died. [Chéng] Yín and [Hóu] Xuǎn went south to enter Hànzhōng. When Hànzhōng was defeated, they visited Tàizǔ to surrender, all restored offices and noble titles.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏略曰：劉雄鳴者，藍田人也。少以采藥射獵為事，常居覆車山下，每晨夜，出行雲霧中，以識道不迷，而時人因謂之能為雲霧。郭、李之亂，人多就之。建安中，附屬州郡，州郡表薦為小將。馬超等反，不肯從，超破之。後詣太祖，太祖執其手謂之曰：「孤方入關，夢得一神人，即卿邪！」乃厚禮之，表拜為將軍，遣令迎其部黨。部黨不欲降，遂劫以反，諸亡命皆往依之，有眾數千人，據武關道口。太祖遣夏侯淵討破之，雄鳴南奔漢中。漢中破，窮無所之，乃復歸降。太祖捉其鬚曰：「老賊，真得汝矣！」復其官，徙勃海。時又有程銀、侯選、李堪，皆河東人也，興平之亂，各有眾千餘家。建安十六年，並與馬超合。超破走，堪臨陳死。銀、選南入漢中，漢中破，詣太祖降，皆復官爵。
:::
:::
:::


## Appraisal {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Appraisal states: Gōngsūn Zàn protected a citadel, sitting and waiting to be exterminated. [Gōngsūn] Dù was cruel and violent and without restraint, [Gōngsūn] Yuān continued the enterprise to accumulate viciousness, only sufficient to overturn their clan. Táo Qiān was ignorant and chaotic and so in distress died, Zhāng Yáng gave up his head by his own subordinates, both embraced and occupied province and prefectures, but did not compare even to common fellows, assuredly not worthy of discussion. [Zhāng] Yàn, [Zhāng] Xiù, [Zhāng] Lǔ gave up crowds of robbers, ranked as accomplished ministers, left danger and destruction, protecting ancestral sacrifices, then in comparison to the others they were better.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
評曰：公孫瓚保京，坐待夷滅。度殘暴而不節，淵仍業以載凶，秪足覆其族也。陶謙昏亂而憂死，張楊授首於臣下，皆擁據州郡，曾匹夫之不若，固無可論者也。燕、繡、魯舍群盜，列功臣，去危亡，保宗祀，則於彼為愈焉。 
:::
:::
